name: AI team · security review, role skills, blind QA
summary: The security-review team with role skills, where QA keeps the real tests from Dev until Verify judges the work.
steps: QA writes a small contract test Dev can see, and hidden acceptance tests
Dev codes one module at a time from the requirement
System runs the hidden tests → Dev sees only which behaviours fail (max 5 rounds)
Security reviewer scans with Semgrep and audits → back to Dev (max 2 rounds)
Reviewer checks every requirement sentence → back to Dev (max 1 round)
